description: HVAC variable speed drive: control word, speed reference, ramp time, status and trip code, output frequency, current, torque and power, inputs, DC bus, temperature and energy meters
source: Guia do usuário do Optidrive ECO, Versão 3.12

sources.title: Guia do usuário do Optidrive ECO
sources.note: linked in issue #119; section 10.2 (Comunicações do Modbus RTU); written for firmware 2.51

notes: Modbus RTU on the RJ45 connector (pin 7 RS485-, pin 8 RS485+), also used by BACnet MS/TP. FC03, FC06 and FC16 (registers 1 to 4 only). Registers are numbered from 1, as in the guide: masters that start at 0 must subtract 1.

Factory settings: address 1 (P5-01, 1 to 63; P5-16 allows 0 to 247), 115.2 kbit/s (P5-03), no parity and 1 stop bit (P5-04 = n-1). P5-04 also allows n-2, odd and even parity with one stop bit; P5-01, P5-03 and P5-04 cannot be changed over Modbus.

Registers 1 and 2 control the drive only when P1-12 = 4 (Modbus RTU) and no fieldbus module is fitted; register 4 needs fieldbus ramp control. Registers 6 to 35 can always be read. Register 3 is reserved.

Every parameter of groups 1 to 5 is also a register: its number is the parameter number (P1-01 is register 101). Values with a decimal point are sent multiplied by 10. Only P1-01 is listed here as an example.

Register 6: the low byte is the status byte, the high byte is the fault number. The guide's text for the pre-ramp speed reference (register 22) gives no scale; it is shown raw. Energy meters are two registers each (kWh and MWh parts) with no stated decimals. The guide is written for firmware 2.51.
Written from the user guide; this map has not been tested on a device.

registers.name: Fast stop
registers.description: 1 = stop with the second deceleration ramp

registers.name: Reset
registers.description: 1 = reset an active trip; set back to 0 after the fault clears

registers.name: Speed reference
registers.description: Setpoint in Hz with one decimal

registers.name: Ramp time
registers.description: Acceleration and deceleration time, 0 to 60000 raw; used when fieldbus ramp control is enabled

registers.name: Trip code
registers.description: Number of the active fault; see the fault list in the guide

registers.name: Digital inputs
registers.description: Bit 0 = digital input 1, and so on

registers.name: Energy kWh (resettable)
registers.description: User-resettable energy meter, kWh part (P0-26); decimals not stated

registers.name: Operating minutes and seconds
registers.description: Total operating time, minutes and seconds (P0-31); packing not described
